title: Trials season 6: Frozen Trials
body:
# Treacherous conditions call for drastic measures

Trials Season 6 has started alongside the launch of Frozen Tail! As Raiders move deeper into Pendola Pass and run into new threats and strange ARC technology, Speranza needs support more than ever.

ARC machines have to be studied as they swarm the surface, supplies have to be gathered to keep day-to-day operations running, and weapons need to be tuned up - this all sounds like a task for a motivated Raider to take on.

# Trials Season 6

**Start date: October 8, 2026**

**End date: November 16, 2026**

Your grand prize for Season 6 is the Maestro Outfit, which dazzles Speranzans with its gilded trim and marks you out as a veteran Raider capable of rallying others to a worthy cause.

Finish your weekly objectives to earn Blueprints and gear as you work your way up toward Cantina Legend!

Lead the way on the leaderboard to claim the Maestro Outfit along with its toggles. Climb to the high ranks of Hotshot and Cantina Legend to unlock the Yellow and Red colors, and earn more cosmetics based on your final season placement:

* Backpack Charm: Sheriff Badge

* Backpack attachment: Infrared Transmitter

* Emote: Pumped Dance

* Scrappy Outfit: Pop Helmet

# New Trials challenges

New ARC threats bring new challenges. Speranza security is calling on all Raiders to take on the Skulker and the Bully, study their combat tactics, and try out their unique new technology.

Trials Season 6 will give you a range of new challenges to complete, including dealing damage with Skulker Turrets and the Bully Cluster Grenade, scavenging in the new hotspots of Pendola Pass, and using the ARC for target practice with your new arsenal.

Take control of the freezing peaks of Pendola Pass, and show that you have what it takes to become a Cantina Legend. Good luck in Trials Season 6!
